description:
You are a search marketing strategist analyzing online channel performance for a client. Using `website_analytics.csv` at `C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\website_analytics.csv` (249 rows with columns: Source / Medium, Year, Month of the year, Users, New Users, Sessions, Bounce Rate, Pageviews, Avg. Session Duration, Conversion Rate (%), Transactions, Revenue, Quantity Sold), build a channel performance report in Power BI Desktop.

IMPORTANT: The CSV stores numbers with comma formatting (e.g., '126,870') and Bounce Rate as a percentage string (e.g., '71.59%'). You must fix these data types in Power Query before building visuals.

The finished report `Channel_Performance.pbix` must be saved on the Desktop and satisfy all of the following:

1. In Power Query Editor, convert the `Revenue` and `Sessions` columns to a numeric (whole number or decimal) data type, removing the comma thousands-separators. Also convert `Bounce Rate` to a decimal by removing the '%' sign.
2. Create a DAX measure named exactly `Revenue_Per_Session` defined as total Revenue divided by total Sessions (use DIVIDE to handle zero denominators).
3. Build a report with exactly these four visuals:
   a. A Line Chart showing Revenue by `Month of the year`, with `Year` as the legend (so each year's monthly revenue appears as a separate line)
   b. A Table visual with `Source / Medium` as rows, sorted by Revenue descending
   c. A Card visual displaying the `Revenue_Per_Session` measure
   d. A Slicer for the `Year` column
4. Save the report as `Channel_Performance.pbix` on the Desktop (`C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\`).

Login: user is `Docker`, no password required.

metadata.data_challenge: comma-formatted numbers and percentage strings requiring Power Query type conversion
